attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Idaho state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Idaho Code § 63-3024: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 5.695%. Standard deductions: $15,000 Single/MFS, $30,000 MFJ/QSS, $22,500 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Idaho Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.695%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Idaho Tax Calculation (top marginal 5.695%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 30000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.05695
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 30000.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.05695 fmul cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 22500.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.05695
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 22500.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.05695 fmul cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 15000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.05695
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 15000.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.05695 fmul cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: ID HOH: 5.695% x max(AGI - $22,500, 0) per Idaho Code § 63-3024
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "ID HOH: 5.695% x max(AGI - $22,500, 0) per Idaho Code § 63-3024"

policy_statement.policy_description: ID Single/MFS: 5.695% x max(AGI - $15,000, 0) per Idaho Code § 63-3024
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "ID Single/MFS: 5.695% x max(AGI - $15,000, 0) per Idaho Code § 63-3024"
